text:
incident-bot: ALERT › Elevated 5xx rate detected in control-plane services (auth, org-lookup) — 02:15 UTC. Threshold exceeded: 5xx > 8% for 3m. Paging on-call.

mike (oncall): ack. seeing spikes in gateway returning 502/504s. paging now.

anya: I can grab auth traces. starting a quick grep on recent request ids.

lucy: I'm on org-lookup side. there are timeouts to billing-service from the rollout job.

sam: Confirmed on logs: a bunch of org-lookup calls to billing hanging ~7s then 502 from gateway. example: `ERROR org.lookup - timeout waiting for billing (id=ab12cd)`

mike (oncall): impact? are customers failing API requests or just internal control-plane ops?

ops_lead: Customer-facing token validations are failing intermittently — affects 3% of traffic globally, higher in us-west. We should enable fallback route to cached-lookup.

anya: quick mitigation idea — enable org-lookup cache-only fallback for 30m while we triage billing calls. That should drop errors immediately.

lucy: +1 — I'll push a conservative routing rule: `if billing-call latency > 1.5s then use cache-fallback`

mike (oncall): go for it. please post command and I'll approve.

lucy: running:```sh
# set route policy to prefer cache on high latency
redwoodctl config set routing.org_lookup.fallback_on_latency=true --threshold=1500
```

dev-tools-bot: exec output: success. policy updated (id: rpolicy-907).

sam: immediate drop in 5xx — graphs show from 9.3% -> 1.8% in 45s. good.

incident-bot: NOTE: service-level errors now stable but still elevated in org-lookup to billing. Continue triage and run mitigations for 30m.

anya: digging into billing logs: saw a surge of retry storms from a background job at 02:10 UTC after a config rollout. lots of concurrent requests with same idempotency key.

sam: can we reduce concurrency or rate-limit rollout jobs? Which config was rolled out?

lucy: rollout was `feature/fast-billing-lookup` — looks like it introduced a heartbeat that triggers billing lookups more frequently.

ops_lead: rollback candidate? or hotfix to the rollout to add jitter and backoff?

mike (oncall): prefer less blast radius: patch the rollout job backoff, keep route fallback enabled until stable, and monitor. If that doesn't improve within 15m, rollback.

anya: applying a temporary rate limit on the rollout worker:```json
{ "source": "billing-rollout", "max_inflight": 10, "backoff_ms": 1200 }
```

dev-tools-bot: rate-limit applied to billing-rollout (rule id rl-432).

sam: nice — billing latency normalized for those endpoints. 5xx remains under 1.5%.

lucy: I'm going to leave the org-lookup fallback for 20 more minutes, then we can progressively relax.

mike (oncall): I'll update customer-ops with impact summary. we should draft a short postmortem stub for the incident channel.

ops_lead: customer note draft: "We observed a control-plane dependency (billing-service) experiencing increased latency following a config rollout, which caused some auth/org-lookup requests to fail. Immediate mitigations (routing fallback to cache, rate-limiting rollout workers) reduced errors. We're monitoring and will follow up with details and root cause analysis."

sam: +1. add affected window: 02:10–02:35 UTC, peak error rate ~9.3%, impacted ~3% of token validation requests (higher in us-west).

mike (oncall): handing off incident to ops_lead for follow-up and RCA. I'll go to next on-call after 10m.

ops_lead: taking over. next steps: schedule RCA meeting, capture config diff for `feature/fast-billing-lookup`, and include rollout job logs. Also propose adding circuit-breaker on control-plane->billing with fail-open to cache.

anya: captured traces and sample request ids: [`ab12cd`, `ef34gh`, `ij56kl`]. uploading to incident artifacts.

dev-tools-bot: artifact uploaded: s3://rbw-incidents/6187654321/traces.tgz

lucy: post-incident checklist: 1) keep fallback for 20m, 2) throttle rollout workers, 3) schedule hotfix to add jitter, 4) RCA.

ops_lead: assigning RCA owners: lucy (org-lookup), anya (billing trace), sam (metrics + customer impact), mike (postmortem).

sam: quick note — we should add a synthetic test for billing-heartbeat to catch this pattern pre-rollout. filing ticket now.

mike (oncall): thanks team. leaving note: incident resolved to mitigation state at 02:20 UTC; monitoring for regression. If errors regress, re-open paging.

ops_lead: closing handoff. moving to incidents/p0-rca. I'll post the RCA link when created. :white_check_mark:

incident-bot: RESOLVED › Control-plane 5xx spike mitigated. Root cause investigation in progress.
